text:
You need a complete GA4 migration, a cleaner Tag Manager setup, new tags added, and fresh GA4 reporting that supports funnel and channel analysis.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. For Verdant Skincare’s marketing attribution analysis, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; 18% of ad budget was reallocated. For Verdant Skincare’s GA4 migration and tracking plan, I built the tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4 before the cut-off; 46 events were mapped with no gap in year-on-year reporting.

I can help clean up your Tag Manager, implement the right tags, and build GA4 reporting for conversion, funnel, and channel performance.
